title: Warehouse management
goal: Capture warehouse receiving and fulfillment functions with a short-pick exception.

rubric.must: Warehouse Management System visibly bounds the warehouse use cases.
Receive Shipment and Pick Order each have a dashed «include» arrow pointing to Scan Goods.
Resolve Short Pick extends Pick Order toward the short pick extension point.
The external ERP System actor is associated with Release Pick Wave and Confirm Shipment.
Forklift Operator generalizes to Picker with a hollow triangle.

ideal.notes: Independent reference drawing following visual-eval/exemplars/usecase/ideal.svg (sha256 7c0fac2f9989). Vision reviewed all six rasterized targets: named subject boundary, external actors, extension-point compartments, include arrows toward included use cases and extend arrows toward bases; long dependencies routed outside unrelated ellipses. Source and rubric unchanged; no engine rendering used as target. Follow-up vision audit: increased Picker association clearance and routed Supervisor to Resolve Short Pick below the unrelated Release Pick Wave ellipse. Extend still points from Short Pick to the base Pick Order.
